meta.note: Light values unified from the three app stylesheets, with cursor/cashier-pos-322f as the canonical source where they disagree. The dark theme is new; no source app has one.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind cards, auth gates and the sale screen. Also the PWA background_color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, stats, the sale ticket, modal sheets, the tab bar and list rows.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, selects, textareas and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: input borders, table rows, cart-line separators, the tab bar's top edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and field. Totals and line names.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and field: stat labels, table headers, hints, empty states, inactive tabs. 4.8:1 on bg (light).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Dinar green. Primary button fill, active chip, active tab text, selected outline.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark text in the dark theme because the fill is lighter there.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Green text on surface and brand-soft: eyebrows, ghost buttons, ok badges. The PWA theme_color (light).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the active tab, ok badges, the due-preview box and a picked cashier.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop side navigation and the mobile top bar.

tokens.name: on-sidebar
tokens.usage: Shop name and nav labels on sidebar.

tokens.name: on-sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: App subtitle and role line on sidebar.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning text on amber-soft: trial pill, open debts, out-for-delivery badge.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Warning ground: trial banner, warn stat, out-for-delivery badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text on danger-soft and surface: low stock, overdue amount, delete, returned orders.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger buttons and bad badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral-new state text on info-soft: new orders.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of new-order badges.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Toast fill.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Toast text on inverse.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal sheets.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every control; at least 3:1 on bg, surface and field in both themes.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: Amount due on the sale ticket. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: total-compact
styles.usage: Amount due on the phone pay bar.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, in the top bar. 18px on phones.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: Shop name in the sidebar and mobile header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: امسح الباركود أو ابحث عن المادة.
styles.usage: Running text and input values (inputs use 600).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Field labels, key-value rows, the signed-in line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, row subtitles, banners, keyboard hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, stat labels, cart-line field labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tab-bar buttons; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Stat label-to-value gap; tab-bar inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap inside a field; search result gap; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default gap between buttons in a row, list rows and grid cells.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles; brand mark to shop name.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input and list-row padding; field bottom margin; phone screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and around the sale layout; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card and modal padding; page gutter on tablets and phones above 400px.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Desktop main area top padding; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Auth card padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Desktop main area side padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, inputs, list buttons, toasts, banners, the brand mark, the camera frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Stat tiles and list-row cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the sale ticket, modal sheets, auth cards. The phone pay bar rounds its top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, the trial pill, header icon buttons.

size.note: Fixed sizes for touch targets and layout tracks.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and the compact ticket inputs on phones.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and nav height; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, scan field, and the Pay button.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop side navigation track (from 980px).

tokens.name: ticket-width
tokens.usage: Sale ticket column on desktop.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Maximum modal sheet width.

tokens.name: gate-width
tokens.usage: Maximum auth and setup card width.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of single-column apps such as the delivery ledger.

tokens.name: desktop-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Sidebar replaces the tab bar at this viewport width and up.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, stats, tickets, modal sheets, auth cards.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone pay bar docked above the tab bar.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar.

tokens.name: z-tabbar
tokens.usage: Fixed bottom tab bar and docked pay bar.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal scrim and sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
